envelope.description: The index queue reports a repository's code-index work

body.title: The index queue reports a repository's code-index work
body.summary: IndexQueue records the job in flight for the duration of processor(job), clearing it in finally, and gains codeIndexWorkFor(repoPath) => { inFlight, pending } counting kind full/reconcile naming repoPath and kind file under repoPath (repoPath or repoPath + separator). depthForRepo is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Pending and in-flight full, reconcile and file jobs for the repository are counted.
Other repositories, a prefix-sharing repository, config, reembed and document-summary jobs are not.
After a throwing processor the in-flight job is cleared.
depthForRepo returns what it did before.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/queue-code-index-work.test.ts: codeIndexWorkFor counts full, reconcile and file jobs for the repository (in flight and pending) and ignores other repositories, a prefix-sharing repository, config, reembed and document-summary jobs; the in-flight job clears after a throwing processor
